EXHIBIT C — SLA EXHIBIT

Exhibit C (SLA Exhibit) to Statement of Work SOW-001 under the Master
Service Agreement between Harborview Health Systems and Trellis Data
Partners, Inc. dated 3 March 2026.

1. PLATFORM UPTIME. Vendor shall maintain platform uptime of ninety-nine
point nine percent (99.9%) measured monthly, excluding scheduled
maintenance windows of up to four (4) hours per month with at least
seventy-two (72) hours' advance notice.

2. SERVICE CREDITS. For each 0.1% shortfall below the 99.9% monthly uptime
target, Client shall receive a service credit equal to five percent (5%) of
that month's subscription fee, capped at thirty percent (30%) of the
monthly fee.

3. INCIDENT RESPONSE. Priority 1 (P1) incidents shall be acknowledged
within fifteen (15) minutes of report, with an initial mitigation status
update provided within one (1) hour.

4. MODEL PERFORMANCE MONITORING. The readmission-risk model's Area Under
the Curve (AUC) shall remain at or above 0.78 in monthly validation
testing. If the AUC falls below 0.78 in any monthly validation cycle,
Vendor shall complete mandatory model retraining within thirty (30) days
at no additional cost to Client.
